title: Philip and the Ethiopian Official
summary: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. Philip helped an Ethiopian official understand Scripture and meet Jesus. When someone has questions, Philip shows kids that explaining the Bible can be an act of love.

read_it.prompt: Read Acts 8:26-40. Watch for what the story shows about scripture.

tell_it: Philip met a man reading Isaiah and explained the good news about Jesus. The man believed and was baptized. That is why Philip and the Ethiopian Official is more than a fact to remember; it is a story with a choice to notice.
understand_it: The point is not that philip and the Ethiopian Official is impressive by itself. God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. When someone has questions, Philip shows kids that explaining the Bible can be an act of love.
age_5_7_explanation: Philip helped an Ethiopian official understand Scripture and meet Jesus.
age_8_11_explanation: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. Ages 8-11 can follow the story by asking what pressure was present and what faithful response looked like.
teen_explanation: Philip and the Ethiopian Official gives teens more than a simple moral. God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. The passage asks what faithful action looks like when emotions, pressure, or consequences are real.
key_truths: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.
Philip and the Ethiopian Official shows scripture through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When someone has questions, Philip shows kids that explaining the Bible can be an act of love.
life_application: When someone has questions, Philip shows kids that explaining the Bible can be an act of love.

quiz_questions.question: What detail should you remember from Philip and the Ethiopian Official?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points to Philip. Remembering that answer helps the story teach scripture with a real Bible detail.

quiz_questions.question: Name the pressure, problem, or need in Philip and the Ethiopian Official.
quiz_questions.answer: Answers should name the story's real challenge and connect it to God's response.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good retelling notices what was hard before jumping straight to the takeaway.

memory_verse.prompt: Use Acts 8:35 as the verse anchor for Philip and the Ethiopian Official.

discussion_questions: Which person in Philip and the Ethiopian Official had a hard choice to make?
What does Philip and the Ethiopian Official show about God, people, or faithful living?
What part of Philip and the Ethiopian Official would be hardest for someone your age?

activity.title: Roadside Bible Help
activity.instructions: Pair up: one asks a Bible question and the other practices a kind, simple answer.

prayer_prompt: Lord, thank You for Philip and the Ethiopian Official. Make scripture more than a word I know; help it shape what I do.
